about: RULES.md rule 4 fired: every pass-1 keep is judged a second time under rule 3. These are the pass-1 keeps without a counted second judgement - never judged a second time, or judged and failed the quote check. Each is judged by an independent Opus judge who does not see pass 1; a keep keeps the row, any other verdict calls the third judge.

rule_4.rule: RULES.md rule 4: if more than 3 of the 60 (5 %) come back not 'keep', every pass-1 'keep' is judged a second time under rule 3
